verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a free developer tier (up to 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM, no credit card) for spinning up a dev instance, which serves as a free sandbox. It also offers isolated branches of production data that can be thrown away, and CHKit commands to validate and test schema and pipelines as code before deploying. missing for 10: a documented local engine or emulator workflow, evidence the dev loop is fast, documented dev-tier limits and quotas beyond CPU/RAM, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
